title: Bound on Visited Tape Cells
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with $k$ work tapes, let $c$ be an initial configuration, and let $L,t$ be natural numbers. If, at every time $u$, the position of work-tape head $i$ lies between $-1$ and $L$, inclusive, then the number of distinct positions visited by that head from time $0$ through time $t$ is at most $L+2$.
hypotheses_covered: Machine M and initial configuration c
For every time u, head i's position is at least -1 and at most L
